description: This file defines the SystemCheckAPI class, an API endpoint for performing system checks during the installation process of the OrangeHRM software. The class extends a parent API class and overrides the handleGet method to include additional checks related to data encryption permissions.

classes.name: SystemCheckAPI
classes.description: API class for performing system checks during installation, extending functionalities from its parent SystemCheckAPI class to include additional verification related to data encryption permissions.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to perform system checks. Adds a check for write permissions on a CryptoKey directory if data encryption is enabled in the database configuration.
